name: anime-manager
description: Local anime management library with Bangumi metadata and mpv integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c cyan,magenta "set BASE_PORT=3457 && npm run dev:server:watch" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:tauri: concurrently -n frontend,server,tauri -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:frontend" "set BASE_PORT=3457 && npm run dev:server:watch" "tauri dev"
scripts.dev:server: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && npm run build:ts && node server/dist/server.js
scripts.dev:server:watch: set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && tsc -p server && concurrently -k "tsc -p server -w --preserveWatchOutput" "nodemon --delay 500 -w server/dist --ignore server/dist/anime-data.json --ignore server/dist/config.json --ignore server/dist/scanned-tree.json --ignore server/dist/data/ --ignore server/dist/covers/ --ignore server/dist/thumbs/ server/dist/server.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles msi nsis
scripts.build:msi: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:nsis: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:server && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:server: cd server && tsc && pkg dist/server.js --target node22-win-x64 --output ../src-tauri/server-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe && node ../scripts/copy-sidecar-deps.js
scripts.dev:prod: npm run build:server && powershell -Command "$p=Start-Process -NoNewWindow -PassThru node -ArgumentList 'server/dist/server.js'; Start-Sleep 3; try { npx tauri dev } finally { $p | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npm run build:ts && node -e "require('./dist/db').ensureSchema()"
